key_structures: Bhramaramba Devi Sanctum atop an elevated terrace behind the main Shiva shrine
Prakara Wall with hundreds of bas-relief panels depicting epics
Mukhamandapa with ornate carved musical pillars
Pathala Ganga Ghat on Krishna river
special_features: Rare holy confluence of a major Jyotirlinga and a Maha Shakti Peetha within a single fortified complex
Eight-armed murti of Bhramaramba vanquishing demon Arunasura through a swarm of black bees
Massive Vijayanagara stone fortress enclosure (prakara) built by Harihara and Bukka Raya
materials: Gold sheet coverings on vimana and dhwaja stambha
renovation_history: Earliest references in Satavahana period; expanded by Ikshvakus, Pallavas, Chalukyas, Kakatiyas, Reddi kings, and crowned by Vijayanagara Emperor Sri Krishnadevaraya in 1516 CE.
